## Goal ID

## Purpose

Governance only. State the workflow, templates, or documentation to add or update.

## Required work branch

codex-max/<goal-id>

## Base branch

project-current

## Required deliverables

List the governance documents / templates to create or update.

## Explicitly out of scope

- No scientific logic or model logic changes.
- No workflow lock changes.
- No generated scientific evidence changes.
- No DataExpansion / Quant04 / RecTiering / dashboard / trading / broker / production / local-lake / factor-mining / DQN-RL.
- No recommendation or position rows; no live data; no ready_factor_count change.

## Required validation

List the validation commands to run on Windows.

## Human action required

Non-author review, then User merge (see docs/governance/HUMAN_APPROVAL_GATE.md).
